answer: Proof-of-burn deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to irrevocably destroy tokens to mint communication tickets. An adversary cannot launch a zephyr of disposable identities without incurring the verifiable economic cost of incinerated capital per instance. Legitimate actors stand out like saffron markers against the umber backdrop of unbonded peer traffic. However, this approach permanently destroys liquidity and prices out low-margin autonomous agents.
